projects.title: Transinaut
projects.stack: TypeScript, Next.js, React, Node.js, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Qdrant, Redis (Upstash)
points: Designed and deployed a full-stack SaaS from scratch: an AI assistant for customs classification (10-digit HS codes) for freight forwarders in Morocco, Canada and Australia, with multi-company management, conversation history and subscription billing (Polar).

Implemented a multi-model RAG pipeline: OpenAI query reformulation, Cohere embed-v4 embeddings, Cohere rerank-v3.5 reranking, Qdrant vector search — served from a dedicated Node.js backend on a VPS, proxied through Next.js 16 / React 19 / TypeScript.

Secured the application in production: httpOnly JWT, Redis rate limiting (Upstash), reCAPTCHA v3, strict CORS, PII masking in logs — multi-tenant architecture with per-company data isolation via Supabase and Polar webhooks.
Active platform: ~1,600 unique visitors and ~4,500 views between February and August 2026.

projects.title: Chronicler
projects.role: Co-developer, team of 3 — led the team to production
projects.stack: Electron, Next.js, React, TypeScript, FastAPI, Python, Docker, Docker Compose
points: An AI assistant that answers questions from a company's own documents (contracts, reports) and can run 100% offline with no data sent to the cloud; 11 signed letters of intent secured from product demos.
Dual-mode architecture (cloud / self-hosted): local LLM and embeddings (Ollama) for offline mode to protect client confidentiality (GDPR), single binary, Docker Compose stack with automated updates.
RAG pipeline on PostgreSQL + pgvector: hybrid search (HNSW + GIN), swappable AI providers with no redeployment needed (Ollama, Cohere, OpenAI).
Asynchronous FastAPI backend: 188 endpoints, JWT, 18 migrations, 22 test modules; drove the team over 5 months prototype to a working release.
